investigations.name: distance-immigration
investigations.description:
Faithful port of IslandManager.simulate's migration loop: for each ordered
island pair (i, j), with probability migration_rate(d_ij) a random present
species moves one individual i -> j. This study isolates the MigrationProcess
coupler: it validates the distance kernel (the colonization/immigration side of
island biogeography) and the conservation law that makes migration a genuine
exchange rather than a source/sink. Islands are held at full occupancy so the
measured immigration reflects the geometry, not transient population collapse.
investigations.title: Isolation reduces colonization; migration conserves individuals
investigations.objective:
Does the distance-decaying migration kernel (migration_rate = 1/(1+distance))
reproduce the immigration side of MacArthur-Wilson theory — more isolated
islands receive fewer colonists — and does inter-island migration conserve
individuals exactly?

investigations.name: island-archipelago
investigations.description:
Faithful port of experiments/island_lotka_volterra.py. Area appears only as
the per-island carrying capacity in the discrete LV update's rescale step.
The study separates the two things "area effect" could mean and shows the
model couples area to abundance (exactly) but not to richness (random
competition collapses each island to a couple of dominant species). Study 3
(island-food-web) shows that trophic interaction structure is what restores
the area-richness relationship.
investigations.title: Carrying capacity sets abundance, not richness
investigations.objective:
In the Lotka-Volterra island model, does island area control the equilibrium
state — and if so, which quantity: total abundance, species richness, or both?

investigations.name: island-food-web
investigations.description:
Faithful port of experiments/island_food_web.py (generate_food_web +
generate_interaction_matrix_from_food_web). The ONLY change from Study 1 is
the interaction matrix; the islands, migration coupler, and dynamics are
identical. The contrast isolates interaction STRUCTURE as the cause of the
species-area law: random competition (Study 1) destroys it, trophic structure
(this study) restores it.
investigations.title: Trophic structure restores the species-area law
investigations.objective:
Does replacing the random interaction matrix with a trophic food web
(producers -> primary -> secondary consumers, antisymmetric predator-prey
couplings) change whether the model reproduces the classic species-area
relationship of island biogeography?
